turns.text: Between 1 October 2026 and 10 October 2026, **88.22%** of revenue came from repeat customers (€2,148.83 out of €2,435.83 total revenue). A repeat customer is defined as any customer whose first order date strictly precedes the order date within the 1 to 10 October 2026 window.

args.sql:
WITH customer_first_orders AS
  (SELECT customer_id,
          MIN(order_date) AS first_order_date
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001`.`bet_bare`.`orders`
   GROUP BY customer_id),
     period_orders AS
  (SELECT o.order_id,
          o.customer_id,
          o.amount,
          o.order_date,
          cfo.first_order_date,
          CASE
              WHEN cfo.first_order_date < o.order_date THEN 'Repeat Customer'
              ELSE 'New Customer'
          END AS customer_type
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001`.`bet_bare`.`orders` AS o
   JOIN customer_first_orders AS cfo ON o.customer_id = cfo.customer_id
   WHERE o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-10' )
SELECT SUM(CASE
               WHEN customer_type = 'Repeat Customer' THEN amount
               ELSE 0
           END) AS repeat_revenue,
       SUM(CASE
               WHEN customer_type = 'New Customer' THEN amount
               ELSE 0
           END) AS new_revenue,
       SUM(amount) AS total_revenue,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(CASE
                                 WHEN customer_type = 'Repeat Customer' THEN amount
                                 ELSE 0
                             END), SUM(amount)) * 100, 2) AS repeat_revenue_pct
FROM period_orders;

turns.text: I assumed 'early October 2026' covers October 1–10, 2026, where search campaign activity is recorded on October 1 and October 2. In early October 2026 (October 1–2, 2026), search campaigns generated **5 leads** from a total ad spend of **€230.00**, resulting in an average cost per lead of **€46.00**.

args.sql:
WITH spend_agg AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          SUM(s.spend) AS total_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.campaigns` c
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.ad_spend` s ON c.campaign_id = s.campaign_id
   WHERE LOWER(c.channel) = 'search'
     AND s.spend_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-10'
   GROUP BY c.channel),
     leads_agg AS
  (SELECT c.channel,
          COUNT(DISTINCT l.lead_id) AS total_leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.campaigns` c
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.leads` l ON c.campaign_id = l.campaign_id
   WHERE LOWER(c.channel) = 'search'
     AND l.created_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-10'
   GROUP BY c.channel)
SELECT spend_agg.channel,
       spend_agg.total_spend,
       leads_agg.total_leads,
       ROUND(spend_agg.total_spend / leads_agg.total_leads, 2) AS cost_per_lead_eur
FROM spend_agg
JOIN leads_agg ON spend_agg.channel = leads_agg.channel;

SELECT spend_data.day,
       spend_data.daily_spend,
       COALESCE(lead_data.daily_leads, 0) AS daily_leads,
       SAFE_DIVIDE(spend_data.daily_spend, lead_data.daily_leads) AS daily_cost_per_lead
FROM
  (SELECT s.spend_date AS DAY,
          SUM(s.spend) AS daily_spend
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.campaigns` c
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.ad_spend` s ON c.campaign_id = s.campaign_id
   WHERE LOWER(c.channel) = 'search'
     AND s.spend_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-10'
   GROUP BY DAY) spend_data
LEFT JOIN
  (SELECT l.created_date AS DAY,
          COUNT(DISTINCT l.lead_id) AS daily_leads
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.campaigns` c
   JOIN `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.leads` l ON c.campaign_id = l.campaign_id
   WHERE LOWER(c.channel) = 'search'
     AND l.created_date BETWEEN '2026-10-01' AND '2026-10-10'
   GROUP BY DAY) lead_data ON spend_data.day = lead_data.day
ORDER BY DAY;

turns.text: Revenue grew by **31.89%** in the week starting Monday 14 September 2026 (€3,284.50) compared to the prior week (€2,490.25).

args.sql:
WITH weekly_rev AS
  (SELECT CASE
              WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-07' AND DATE '2026-09-13' THEN '2026-09-07 to 2026-09-13 (Previous Week)'
              WHEN order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-14' AND DATE '2026-09-20' THEN '2026-09-14 to 2026-09-20 (Target Week)'
          END AS week_label,
          SUM(amount) AS total_revenue
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.orders`
   WHERE order_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-07' AND DATE '2026-09-20'
   GROUP BY 1),
     pivoted AS
  (SELECT MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_label LIKE '%Previous%' THEN total_revenue
              END) AS prev_week_revenue,
          MAX(CASE
                  WHEN week_label LIKE '%Target%' THEN total_revenue
              END) AS target_week_revenue
   FROM weekly_rev)
SELECT prev_week_revenue,
       target_week_revenue,
       target_week_revenue - prev_week_revenue AS revenue_growth,
       ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(target_week_revenue - prev_week_revenue, prev_week_revenue) * 100, 2) AS growth_percentage
FROM pivoted

turns.text: In the week of 14 September 2026, booking value grew by **€5,700 (+20.73%)** from €27,500 to €33,200, while the number of bookings increased by **3 (+27.27%)** from 11 to 14 compared to the previous week (starting 7 September 2026).

args.sql:
WITH weekly_bookings AS
  (SELECT DATE_TRUNC(booked_date, WEEK(MONDAY)) AS week_start,
          SUM(amount) AS total_amount,
          COUNT(booking_id) AS total_bookings
   FROM `pplk8s-lab-001.bet_bare.bookings`
   WHERE booked_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-07' AND DATE '2026-09-20'
   GROUP BY 1),
     comparison AS
  (SELECT w_curr.week_start AS current_week,
          w_curr.total_amount AS current_amount,
          w_curr.total_bookings AS current_bookings,
          w_prev.week_start AS previous_week,
          w_prev.total_amount AS previous_amount,
          w_prev.total_bookings AS previous_bookings,
          (w_curr.total_amount - w_prev.total_amount) AS amount_diff,
          ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(w_curr.total_amount - w_prev.total_amount, w_prev.total_amount) * 100, 2) AS amount_growth_pct,
          (w_curr.total_bookings - w_prev.total_bookings) AS bookings_count_diff,
          ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(w_curr.total_bookings - w_prev.total_bookings, w_prev.total_bookings) * 100, 2) AS bookings_count_growth_pct
   FROM weekly_bookings AS w_curr
   LEFT JOIN weekly_bookings AS w_prev ON w_prev.week_start = DATE_SUB(w_curr.week_start, INTERVAL 1 WEEK)
   WHERE w_curr.week_start = DATE '2026-09-14' )
SELECT *
FROM comparison;

WITH weekly_leads AS

FROM leads_with_lag
WHERE week_start = DATE '2026-09-14'
ORDER BY week_start;

       o.total_orders,
       COALESCE(r.total_returns_count, 0) AS total_returns_count
FROM daily_orders o
FULL OUTER JOIN daily_returns r ON o.order_date = r.return_date;
